page: Microsoft Azure DC64as_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached storage, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. Additionally, the server does not feature any integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density make this instance suitable for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of specialized hardware. The resource profile is aligned with general-purpose enterprise workloads, including medium-to-large databases, web serving fleets, application servers, and containerized microservices that require a steady balance of memory and processing power.
